purpose: Botanical and general external LC-MS/MS validation candidates for Nexora Phases 1I and 1K
policy: No dataset is a benchmark until file inventory, study-specific reuse licence, metadata linkage, injection order, QC roles, and checksums are verified.

candidates.title: Solvent-dependent metabolomic profiling of Acacia mearnsii bark: an untargeted metabolomics approach
evidence_reported_in_publication: Botanical matrix: Acacia mearnsii bark, rich in condensed tannins and proanthocyanidins.
Untargeted UHPLC-QTOF-MS with ESI positive and negative ionization modes.
Eight extraction solvent conditions, including aqueous, acetone-water, ethanol-water and methanol-water mixtures.
Five independent extraction experiments are reported.
Pooled-QC samples were prepared by combining aliquots from individual extracts.
Solvent blanks and process blanks were included.
Samples were randomized; pooled-QC injections were used for system conditioning and repeated every five sample injections.
The article reports Bruker .d raw-data files converted to mzML with Data Analysis 4.3, and raw MS data deposited in MetaboLights under MTBLS13040.
The article reports MS/MS data also deposited in GNPS MassIVE under MSV000098533.
not_yet_verified: Current accession-level reuse licence and any submitter-specific conditions.
Complete live MetaboLights public archive listing and exact availability of every referenced Bruker .d directory bundle.
Current Investigation, Sample and all Assay metadata, with their SHA-256 hashes.
Unambiguous mapping of every selected sample, assay, polarity, raw/derived path and method.
Actual injection-order values and supporting source record; randomization described in the paper is not a substitute for a run-order table.
Exact pooled-QC, blank and standard counts per method and polarity.
Whether mzML files are present in the MetaboLights archive; the publication's conversion statement does not prove that the derived mzML files are deposited there.
Whether Data Analysis 4.3 or an independently qualified conversion route is available and licensed.
SHA-256 hashes of selected raw or converted data after authorized transfer.
candidates.planned_use: First-choice K0 botanical pilot. Select one homogeneous untargeted UHPLC-QTOF acquisition stratum at a time; keep positive and negative polarities separate. No raw download or processing before K0 PASS.

candidates.title: LC-MS based plant metabolic profiles of thirteen grassland species grown in diverse neighbourhoods
evidence_reported_in_publication: Plant metabolic profiles from thirteen grassland species.
mzML data are reported as available through MetaboLights.
Pooled-QC samples, field blanks and extraction blanks are described; the publication reports 73 pooled-QC runs across twelve batches.
not_yet_verified: Current accession-level licence and submitter conditions; this is a pre-April-2025 study.
Current public archive completeness, exact file counts and ISA-Tab assay-to-file mappings.
Injection order and exact pooled-QC distribution within each of the twelve batches.
Whether each batch individually satisfies Nexora 1J QC-RLSC feature-level QC coverage.
Checksums and independent reprocessing suitability.
candidates.planned_use: Secondary botanical positive-mode benchmark for a later supporting study; not a substitute for a dual-polarity phytochemical pilot.

candidates.title: Untargeted LC-MS metabolomics of feces, intestinal contents and serum from mice
evidence_reported_in_public_catalogue: Untargeted reverse-phase LC-MS positive and negative ionization modes.
Mouse feces, intestinal-content and serum matrices.
Pooled quality-control samples and analytical blanks are described.
not_yet_verified: Current public archive directory and complete file listing.
Exact study-specific licence record and any submitter restrictions.
Exact vendor/open formats and file sizes, including actual mzML availability.
ISA-Tab investigation/sample/assay file completeness and mapping.
Confirmed pooled-QC, solvent-blank and extraction-blank roles.
Injection order and separation by chromatographic method/polarity.
SHA-256 of selected source data files.
candidates.planned_use: General LC-MS/MS pipeline candidate only; not a botanical phytochemistry benchmark.

synthetic_test_data.purpose: Exercise inventory parsing, QC-role candidate classification and K0 gate logic without network access.
